name: ServerSnapshot
short: Private, integrity-checked guild snapshots with historical-message archives and controlled restoration.
description: Owner-only server archive and reconstruction: roles, channels, permissions, threads, members, integrations inventory, full accessible message history and Discord CDN media. Restore structure first, optionally replay labelled historical messages, restore assets/member roles/settings with separate confirmation. Never auto-reinstalls apps or forges user authorship.
install_msg: Use ~sbackup for commands. Grant Fatboy access to channels/history plus Manage Roles/Channels for restore. Enable Message Content and Server Members intents. Backups are stored locally on the VPS, never in Discord.
end_user_data_statement: Archives guild metadata, accessible messages and attachments, usernames, user IDs, member role assignments and app inventories in owner-private files on the VPS. Archives are retained until the operator deletes them.
